judgmentCalls: 2610.28731v1 was placed only in Comparisons & systematics because its central result is a cross-mechanism velocity-distribution systematic covering elastic and inelastic operators, rather than a single recoil model.

2610.29335v1 was placed only in Electroweak inelastic DM because the pseudo-Dirac electroweak-doublet transition is central to its LZ interpretation; reheating and leptogenesis are secondary cosmological metadata.
The additions received semantic coordinates near their mechanism families and the next contiguous layout ranks 137 and 138; all established coordinates and ranks remain unchanged.

INSPIRE's displayed count rose from 147 to 150. All three newly indexed IDs in the refreshed newest results were staged, including 2610.28731 and 2610.28758 below the first prior-frontier hit, so the count and citation-neighbor delta reconcile without silently skipping late-indexed papers.
2610.28758v1 was excluded because its direct-detection discussion is generic and does not analyze the isolated 248 keV candidate; three same-name author-search collisions were also excluded.
The pre-existing 2609.06640v2 human-review item remains unchanged; its public catalog record and citation edges stay pinned to v1 pending editorial review.
